basic_info.description:
Discover urban sophistication at its finest in this contemporary condo, located in the prestigious LEED-certified Arterra building within the vibrant Mission Bay neighborhood. This modern 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit features a stylish kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, a brand-new gas stove, and allergy-free carpeting in the bedroom. The floors throughout the unit have been replaced with non-toxic materials in a chic, modern color, and the convenience of a brand-new washer and dryer is included in-unit.

Relax and take in breathtaking views from the panoramic roof deck or enjoy the BBQ area, fitness center, and recreation room with a kitchen and complimentary Wi-Fi. The building offers luxury living with a 24/7 doorman in the lobby to greet you.

The rental includes a spacious parking spot suitable for SUVs, along with a bike rack in the community garage. Benefit from the prime location near Caltrain, Muni, and easy access to highways 101 and 280. You're also just a short walk from the SF Giants stadium, Safeway, and more.

Available starting October 1, 2024.

For inquiries or to schedule a viewing, please contact me via email.

Owner pays for trash, sewer and water. Tenant responsible for gas and electric.
